references.title: Align UI social buttons structure
adopt: Keep labelled and icon-only social actions as separate component identities.
Place one recognizable social platform mark before the visible label in the labelled control.
Expose the same size, emphasis, and native interaction-state matrix as the existing Button and IconButton contracts.
avoid: Do not copy provider-colored surfaces, third-party component APIs, labels, spacing values, or proprietary assets from the reference.
Do not propagate the reference treatment beyond SocialButton and SocialIconButton.
references.notes: The screenshot is structural evidence only. Production geometry, tokens, icons, semantics, and states remain owned by the local design system.
references.rights: User-supplied screenshot used only as a local structural design reference; do not redistribute or extract third-party assets.

references.title: Align UI File Upload structural anatomy
adopt: Keep the drop target, fixed upload icon, concise label, format guidance and explicit browse action in one readable hierarchy.
Cover default, hover, focus, dragging, selected, invalid and disabled presentation while native behavior owns runtime state.
Preserve a generous hit target and fluid width without copying the benchmark fixture dimensions.
avoid: Do not copy Align UI tokens, raw values, code, icons, public API or proprietary assets.
Do not add transport, queue state or a public interaction-state prop to FileUpload.
references.notes: Local wireframe records structure only from the user-supplied Figma benchmark node 450:9413; production rendering remains owned by the local system.
references.rights: Locally authored structural wireframe based on a user-supplied benchmark; contains no extracted third-party artwork.

references.title: Align UI File Upload Card structural anatomy
adopt: Keep file identity, metadata, explicit status, contextual action and progress in a compact card hierarchy.
Cover determinate and indeterminate uploading, success and recoverable error states.
Let metadata and actions wrap in narrow containers without changing source order.
avoid: Do not copy benchmark-specific format icons, state icons, colors, token names, dimensions or component API.
Do not make color the only status cue or move transport ownership into the card.
references.notes: Local wireframe records structure only from the user-supplied Figma benchmark node 451:409; production rendering remains owned by the local system.
references.rights: Locally authored structural wireframe based on a user-supplied benchmark; contains no extracted third-party artwork.

references.title: Align UI horizontal Tab Menu benchmark
adopt: Use a quiet horizontal rhythm that remains subordinate to primary actions.
Keep a clear current-location indicator and readable spacing between native anchor destinations.
Preserve horizontal access to every item in narrow containers through controlled inline scrolling.
avoid: Do not copy the benchmark API, tokens, icons, badges, item-count variants, overflow action, content or raw dimensions.
Do not treat the reference as a dependency or require pixel parity with the local Astro component.
references.notes: User-supplied node 3511:9958 is a qualitative benchmark for rhythm, horizontal structure and the active indicator only. Local tokens, semantics and runtime behavior own production.
references.rights: User-supplied Figma reference used only as a bounded qualitative benchmark; do not redistribute or extract third-party assets.

references.title: Align UI modal anatomy benchmark
adopt: Keep one focused panel with a semantic status visual, title, supporting copy, preference and ordered actions.
Cover error, warning, success and informational states in both horizontal and vertical content layouts.
Keep footer controls available while long body content scrolls within a viewport-bounded panel.
avoid: Do not copy the benchmark code, public API, token names, icons, content, raw dimensions or proprietary assets.
Do not treat the external node as a canonical Figma master or require pixel parity with Popup.
references.notes: User-supplied node 480:1372 is a qualitative anatomy and execution benchmark only. Popup remains an Astro-only native dialog owned by the local component and token contracts.
references.rights: User-supplied Figma reference used only as a bounded qualitative benchmark; do not redistribute or extract third-party assets.

references.title: Align UI modal overlay benchmark
adopt: Dim the complete viewport behind the modal surface.
Keep the overlay neutral and consistent between light and dark color modes.
Let the platform modal top layer own stacking and viewport coverage.
avoid: Do not create a second public Overlay component for Popup.
Do not copy the benchmark opacity, color token, stacking implementation or extracted assets.
references.notes: User-supplied node 480:2474 records overlay intent only. Production uses dialog::backdrop and the approved local black/20% global overlay semantic.
references.rights: User-supplied Figma reference used only as a bounded qualitative benchmark; do not redistribute or extract third-party assets.
